**Alexander the Great**  
- Macedonian king (356 – 323 BC)  
- Son of King Philip II and Queen Olympias  
- Became king at age 20 after his father's death  
- Conquered the Persian Empire, Egypt, and parts of India  
- Created one of the largest empires of the ancient world  
- Known for military genius, spreading Greek culture (Hellenism)  
- Died in Babylon at 32, leaving a lasting legacy in history.
